English: Nairobi, Kenya, 12 May 2026 — The United Nations Population Fund, UNFPA, in partnership with the Government of Japan, today launched two new projects aimed at strengthening sexual and reproductive health and rights, preventing and responding to gender-based violence, and empowering women and young people in Kenya.

Kiswahili: Serikali imejitolea kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu katika ngazi zote na katika sehemu zote za nchi.
Metadata: Education access policy

English: The Ministry of Education engages in continuous consultation with stakeholders with a view to fostering participatory development.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu hushiriki katika mashauriano endelevu na wadau kwa lengo la kukuza maendeleo shirikishi.
Metadata: Education access policy

English: PS Bitok today visited Kyamboo School in Kitui County to assess the ongoing Grade 10 transition under the Competency Based Curriculum.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu Bitok leo ametembelea Shule ya Kyamboo katika Kaunti ya Kitui ili kutathmini mpito unaoendelea wa Darasa la 10 chini ya Mtaala Unaozingatia Ustadi.
Metadata: Grade 10 transition tour

English: He confirmed that Grade 10 textbooks have been delivered supported by a 5.6 billion government investment and reaffirmed the commitment to achieving 100 percent transition of selected learners.
Kiswahili: Alithibitisha kwamba vitabu vya kiada vya darasa la 10 vimetolewa kwa usaidizi wa uwekezaji wa serikali wa dola bilioni 5.6 na akathibitisha tena kujitolea kwao kufikia asilimia 100 ya mpito wa wanafunzi waliochaguliwa.
Metadata: Textbook delivery confirmation

English: PS Bitok concluded the Kitui County tour with visits to Kwa Ukungu Junior Senior and Special Schools where he reaffirmed government support for school development and inclusive education.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu Bitok alihitimisha ziara ya Kaunti ya Kitui kwa kutembelea Shule za Wazee na Maalum za Kwa Ukungu ambapo alithibitisha tena uungaji mkono wa serikali kwa maendeleo ya shule na elimu jumuishi.
Metadata: School tour

English: The Grade 10 transition under the Competency Based Curriculum now stands at 98 percent reflecting steady nationwide progress.
Kiswahili: Mpito wa Darasa la 10 chini ya Mtaala Unaozingatia Ustadi sasa unasimama kwa asilimia 98 ukionyesha maendeleo thabiti ya kitaifa.
Metadata: Grade 10 transition progress

English: PS later toured St Mathias Mulumba Matinyani Boys Secondary School where he confirmed receipt of Grade 10 textbooks and assured the institution of continued government support including plans to construct a dormitory to improve accommodation and learning conditions.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu baadaye alitembelea Shule ya Upili ya Wavulana ya St Mathias Mulumba Matinyani ambapo alithibitisha kupokea vitabu vya kiada vya darasa la 10 na kuihakikishia taasisi hiyo msaada endelevu wa serikali ikiwa ni pamoja na mipango ya kujenga mabweni ili kuboresha malazi na mazingira ya kujifunzia.
Metadata: School infrastructure support

English: Heads of Institution are under duty to ensure that learners' registration details are correctly captured, so that no learner is disenfranchised.
Kiswahili: Wakuu wa Taasisi wana wajibu wa kuhakikisha kwamba maelezo ya usajili wa wanafunzi yanaandikwa kwa usahihi, ili hakuna mwanafunzi anayenyimwa haki ya kujiunga na chuo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education officially launched the 2026 examination and assessment candidates' registration season at the KNEC offices in South C.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alizindua rasmi msimu wa usajili wa wagombea wa mtihani na tathmini wa 2026 katika ofisi za KNEC huko South C.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education graced the Safaricom M-Pesa Foundation-funded facilities handover ceremony at the University of Embu TVET Institute.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu alihudhuria sherehe ya makabidhiano ya vifaa vilivyofadhiliwa na Wakfu wa Safaricom M-Pesa katika Taasisi ya TVET ya Chuo Kikuu cha Embu.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education held a meeting with the Cabinet Secretary for Health at the Ministry of Health offices at Afya House, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alifanya mkutano na Waziri wa Afya katika ofisi za Wizara ya Afya House, Nairobi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education joined the President for the inaugural graduation ceremony of the National Intelligence Research University of Kenya in Loresho, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alijiunga na Rais katika sherehe ya ufunguzi wa mahafali ya Chuo Kikuu cha Utafiti wa Ujasusi cha Kenya huko Loresho, Nairobi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education graced the launch of the Harnessing Education Research for Impact (HERI) Africa initiative at Kisii University.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alihudhuria uzinduzi wa mpango wa Harnessing Education Research for Impact (HERI) Africa katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kisii.

English: HERI Africa is designed to bridge the gap between academic research and practical impact by strengthening collaboration, mentorship and knowledge exchange across institutions.
Kiswahili: HERI Africa imeundwa ili kuziba pengo kati ya utafiti wa kitaaluma na athari za vitendo kwa kuimarisha ushirikiano, ushauri na ubadilishanaji wa maarifa katika taasisi mbalimbali.

English: The initiative will support the translation of research findings into policies and programmes that address real societal challenges.
Kiswahili: Mpango huu utasaidia tafsiri ya matokeo ya utafiti katika sera na programu zinazoshughulikia changamoto halisi za kijamii.

English: The Government is working to enhance access to quality and relevant training to our youth through TVET institutions.
Kiswahili: Serikali inafanya kazi ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa mafunzo bora na yanayofaa kwa vijana wetu kupitia taasisi za TVET.

English: One of the strategies is expanding the infrastructural capacity of our institutions.
Kiswahili: Mojawapo ya mikakati ni kupanua uwezo wa miundombinu wa taasisi zetu.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education commissioned a newly built multi-storey academic block at the Kenya Coast National Polytechnic in Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu aliagiza jengo jipya la kitaaluma lenye ghorofa nyingi lililojengwa katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kitaifa cha Ufundi cha Pwani ya Kenya huko Mombasa.

English: The World Food Programme has been a key partner in Kenya's school meals journey, starting our national programme in 1980.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Chakula Duniani umekuwa mshirika muhimu katika safari ya milo shuleni nchini Kenya, ukianza programu yetu ya kitaifa mwaka wa 1980.

English: Today's meeting discussed mechanisms for deepening partnerships for resource mobilization as part of Kenya's efforts towards reaching 10 million learners by 2030.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa leo ulijadili mbinu za kuimarisha ushirikiano wa uhamasishaji wa rasilimali kama sehemu ya juhudi za Kenya za kuwafikia wanafunzi milioni 10 ifikapo mwaka wa 2030.

English: The Africa Day of School Feeding is an annual forum under the high patronage of the African Union, to evaluate advancements and chart pathways for better delivery of school meals programmes across the continent.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Afrika ya Kulisha Watoto Shuleni ni jukwaa la kila mwaka chini ya ufadhili mkubwa wa Umoja wa Afrika, ili kutathmini maendeleo na kupanga njia za utoaji bora wa programu za milo shuleni kote barani.

English: The Cabinet Secretary and the High Commissioner discussed the state of bilateral ties between Kenya and Botswana in the education sector, and action points for deepening and strengthening the ties.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri na Kamishna Mkuu walijadili hali ya uhusiano wa pande mbili kati ya Kenya na Botswana katika sekta ya elimu, na hatua za kuimarisha na kuimarisha uhusiano huo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education opened the 2026 Public Universities Vice-Chancellors' Summit at PrideInn Paradise Resort in Mombasa, bringing together leaders of public universities and key stakeholders.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alifungua Mkutano wa Makamu wa Chansela wa Vyuo Vikuu vya Umma wa 2026 katika Hoteli ya PrideInn Paradise huko Mombasa, akiwaleta pamoja viongozi wa vyuo vikuu vya umma na wadau muhimu.

English: The forum brings together stakeholders to address county-specific education priorities under the Listen! Fix! Deliver! approach.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa hili linawaleta pamoja wadau ili kushughulikia vipaumbele vya elimu mahususi kwa kaunti chini ya mbinu ya Sikiliza! Fix! Deliver!.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education graced the inaugural graduation ceremony of the Baringo National Polytechnic, marking the culmination of the skilling journey for yet another cohort in Kenya's reformed TVET system.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alihudhuria sherehe ya kuhitimu kwa mara ya kwanza ya Chuo Kikuu cha Kitaifa cha Baringo, akiashiria kilele cha safari ya ujuzi kwa kundi lingine katika mfumo wa TVET uliorekebishwa nchini Kenya.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education presided over the 66th Anniversary Celebrations of Nyambaria High School in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu aliongoza sherehe za kuadhimisha miaka 66 ya Shule ya Upili ya Nyambaria katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.

English: The engagements reinforced the Government's commitment to expanding access to quality education and strengthening learning infrastructure across the country.
Kiswahili: Mashirikiano hayo yaliimarisha dhamira ya Serikali ya kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu bora na kuimarisha miundombinu ya kujifunzia kote nchini.

English: Investments in classrooms, laboratories, dormitories, and other essential facilities are aimed at creating a conducive learning environment that supports academic excellence, enhances student welfare, and enables every learner to thrive.
Kiswahili: Uwekezaji katika madarasa, maabara, mabweni, na vifaa vingine muhimu unalenga kuunda mazingira mazuri ya kujifunzia ambayo yanaunga mkono ubora wa kitaaluma, huongeza ustawi wa wanafunzi, na kuwezesha kila mwanafunzi kustawi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education graced the inaugural Elgeyo Marakwet Elimu Conference at the Lorna Kiplagat Academy in Elgeyo Marakwet County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alihudhuria Mkutano wa kwanza wa Elimu wa Elgeyo Marakwet katika Chuo cha Lorna Kiplagat katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet.

English: Education stakeholders were brought together to deliberate on strategies for enhancing educational outcomes in Elgeyo Marakwet County through stronger collaboration.
Kiswahili: Wadau wa elimu walikusanyika pamoja ili kujadili mikakati ya kuboresha matokeo ya elimu katika Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet kupitia ushirikiano imara zaidi.

English: The Cabinet Secretary toured Kitale National Polytechnic, where he assessed ongoing government projects, including the construction of 2,400-bed hostels at the institution.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri alitembelea Chuo Kikuu cha Kitaifa cha Polytechnic cha Kitale, ambapo alitathmini miradi inayoendelea ya serikali, ikiwa ni pamoja na ujenzi wa hosteli zenye vitanda 2,400 katika taasisi hiyo.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education accompanied the President to Toroso Primary School, as part of the President's development tour of the Western region.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu aliandamana na Rais hadi Shule ya Msingi ya Toroso, kama sehemu ya ziara ya Rais ya maendeleo katika eneo la Magharibi.

English: The President commissioned newly constructed, state-of-the-art classrooms funded by the M-Pesa Foundation, worth Ksh. 60 million.
Kiswahili: Rais aliagiza madarasa mapya ya kisasa yaliyojengwa kwa ufadhili wa M-Pesa Foundation, yenye thamani ya shilingi milioni 60.

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education graced the inaugural Koitaleel Samoei International Conference at Koitaleel Samoei University College, Mosoriot Campus in Nandi County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alihudhuria Mkutano wa kwanza wa Kimataifa wa Koitaleel Samoei katika Chuo Kikuu cha Koitaleel Samoei, Kampasi ya Mosoriot katika Kaunti ya Nandi.

English: The future of Kenya's children begins with foundational learning.
Kiswahili: Mustakabali wa watoto wa Kenya huanza na kujifunza kwa msingi.

English: Join us at the National Foundational Learning Conference 2026 as we Launch, Learn, and Lead!
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi katika Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Kujifunza Msingi 2026 tunapozindua, Kujifunza, na Kuongoza!

English: Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology witnessed the official handover of Butula Campus, via a signed MoU to fast-track its development into a fully fledged institution.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Sayansi na Teknolojia cha Masinde Muliro kilishuhudia makabidhiano rasmi ya Kampasi ya Butula, kupitia MoU iliyosainiwa ili kuharakisha maendeleo yake kuwa taasisi kamili.

English: This will boost university access in Busia County and Butula Constituency, drive socio-economic growth and jobs under the Bottom-Up Agenda, and advance skills development through strategic partnerships for Kenya's benefit.
Kiswahili: Hii itaongeza ufikiaji wa vyuo vikuu katika Kaunti ya Busia na Jimbo la Butula, itachochea ukuaji wa kijamii na kiuchumi na ajira chini ya Ajenda ya Kuanza Kusoma, na itaendeleza ukuzaji wa ujuzi kupitia ushirikiano wa kimkakati kwa manufaa ya Kenya.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education officially launched the Africa University Summit at the Kenyatta International Conference Centre.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu alizindua rasmi Mkutano wa Vyuo Vikuu vya Afrika katika Kituo cha Mikutano cha Kimataifa cha Kenyatta.

English: The two-day summit brought together South Africa's Minister for Higher Education, international university presidents, Vice-Chancellors, and civil society leaders, focused on powering Africa's future through talent development, innovation, and inclusion.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo wa siku mbili uliwakutanisha Waziri wa Elimu ya Juu wa Afrika Kusini, marais wa vyuo vikuu vya kimataifa, Makamu wa Chansela, na viongozi wa asasi za kiraia, uliolenga kuimarisha mustakabali wa Afrika kupitia ukuzaji wa vipaji, uvumbuzi, na ujumuishaji.

English: Following allegations questioning the bona fides of some graduands at Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology, the Cabinet Secretary directed the Commission for University Education to undertake a thorough investigation.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia madai ya kuhoji uaminifu wa baadhi ya wahitimu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Sayansi na Teknolojia cha Masinde Muliro, Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri aliagiza Tume ya Elimu ya Vyuo Vikuu kufanya uchunguzi wa kina.

English: The Commission is required to ascertain that all graduands were in fact students at the University, and that they duly qualified for the award of the qualifications that were conferred upon them.
Kiswahili: Tume inahitajika kuthibitisha kwamba wahitimu wote walikuwa wanafunzi katika Chuo Kikuu, na kwamba walihitimu ipasavyo kwa ajili ya kupewa sifa walizopewa.

English: The Ministry of Education is committed to promoting and strengthening the credibility of our education and qualifications system, in order to safeguard our reputation as a regional and international education hub.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imejitolea kukuza na kuimarisha uaminifu wa mfumo wetu wa elimu na sifa, ili kulinda sifa yetu kama kitovu cha elimu cha kikanda na kimataifa.

English: This marked the first-ever March graduation in the university's history, offering an opportunity for graduands who had previously missed out.
Kiswahili: Hii ilikuwa mahafali ya kwanza kabisa ya Machi katika historia ya chuo kikuu, ikitoa fursa kwa wahitimu ambao hapo awali walikuwa wamekosa.

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education toured Murang'a University of Technology to assess key projects under the BETA agenda.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu alizuru Chuo Kikuu cha Teknolojia cha Murang'a ili kutathmini miradi muhimu chini ya ajenda ya BETA.

English: This morning, the Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, together with his Health counterpart, Hon. Aden Duale, inaugurated the Multi-Sectoral Technical Working Group on Education and Training of Healthcare Providers at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Asubuhi ya leo, Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, pamoja na mwenzake wa Afya, Mhe. Aden Duale, walizindua Kikosi Kazi cha Kiufundi cha Sekta Mbalimbali kuhusu Elimu na Mafunzo ya Watoa Huduma za Afya katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.
Metadata: Multi-Sectoral Working Group launch

English: The Working Group brings together officers from professional and regulatory bodies at the Ministries of Education and Health, to ensure alignment in the education and training of healthcare professionals in the country.
Kiswahili: Kundi Kazi linawaleta pamoja maafisa kutoka vyombo vya kitaaluma na udhibiti katika Wizara za Elimu na Afya, ili kuhakikisha upatanifu katika elimu na mafunzo ya wataalamu wa afya nchini.
Metadata: Multi-Sectoral Working Group launch

English: The meeting was also attended by the Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, the Principal Secretary for Public Health and Professional Standards, Mary Muthoni, and the Principal Secretary for Basic Education, Amb. Prof. Julius Bitok.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo pia ulihudhuriwa na Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, Katibu Mkuu wa Afya ya Umma na Viwango vya Kitaalamu, Mary Muthoni, na Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Msingi, Balozi Profesa Julius Bitok.
Metadata: Multi-Sectoral Working Group launch

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, hosted Prof. Juan E. Gonzalez of the University of Texas at Dallas, alongside representatives from Kenyan universities, to strengthen global partnerships.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alimkaribisha Prof. Juan E. Gonzalez wa Chuo Kikuu cha Texas huko Dallas, pamoja na wawakilishi kutoka vyuo vikuu vya Kenya, ili kuimarisha ushirikiano wa kimataifa.
Metadata: University of Texas at Dallas partnership visit

English: She emphasized higher education's role in Kenya's BETA agenda and highlighted collaboration opportunities in research, capacity building, innovation, and dual degree programmes.
Kiswahili: Alisisitiza jukumu la elimu ya juu katika ajenda ya BETA ya Kenya na akaangazia fursa za ushirikiano katika utafiti, ujenzi wa uwezo, uvumbuzi, na programu za shahada mbili.
Metadata: University of Texas at Dallas partnership visit

English: Prof. Gonzalez praised Kenyan talent and expressed interest in establishing a centre in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Profesa Gonzalez alisifu vipaji vya Wakenya na akaonyesha nia ya kuanzisha kituo nchini Kenya.
Metadata: University of Texas at Dallas partnership visit

English: The Republic of Kenya and the Kingdom of Morocco enjoy strong and long running bilateral ties, including in the field of education.
Kiswahili: Jamhuri ya Kenya na Ufalme wa Moroko zinafurahia uhusiano imara na wa muda mrefu wa pande mbili, ikiwa ni pamoja na katika uwanja wa elimu.
Metadata: Kenya-Morocco Joint Commission

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, attended the inaugural Joint Commission for Cooperation between Kenya and Morocco.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria mkutano wa kwanza wa Tume ya Pamoja ya Ushirikiano kati ya Kenya na Morocco.
Metadata: Kenya-Morocco Joint Commission

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education signed a Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation between Kenya and Morocco in the field of Higher Education.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu alisaini Mkataba wa Makubaliano ya Ushirikiano kati ya Kenya na Morocco katika uwanja wa Elimu ya Juu.
Metadata: Kenya-Morocco MOU

English: The Memorandum of Understanding provides a renewed framework for cooperation in key areas of human capital development such as provision of scholarships, knowledge exchange and joint research.
Kiswahili: Mkataba wa Maelewano hutoa mfumo mpya wa ushirikiano katika maeneo muhimu ya maendeleo ya rasilimali watu kama vile utoaji wa ufadhili wa masomo, ubadilishanaji wa maarifa na utafiti wa pamoja.
Metadata: Kenya-Morocco MOU

English: The event was also attended by, among others, the Cabinet Secretary for Health, Hon. Aden Duale, and the Cabinet Secretary for Gender, Culture, the Arts and Heritage, Hannah Cheptumo Wendot.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo pia ilihudhuriwa na, miongoni mwa wengine, Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Afya, Mhe. Aden Duale, na Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Jinsia, Utamaduni, Sanaa na Urithi, Hannah Cheptumo Wendot.
Metadata: Kenya-Morocco MOU

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, assessed the progress of the ongoing construction of Nyamira University College at Kiabonyoru Grounds in Nyamira County ahead of the President's visit scheduled for Monday.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitathmini maendeleo ya ujenzi unaoendelea wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nyamira katika Viwanja vya Kiabonyoru katika Kaunti ya Nyamira kabla ya ziara ya Rais iliyopangwa kufanyika Jumatatu.
Metadata: Nyamira University College construction

English: He commended the contractors and the government's commitment to timely completion, with plans on course for the admission of the first cohort of students in September 2026.
Kiswahili: Aliwapongeza wakandarasi na kujitolea kwa serikali kukamilisha kwa wakati, huku mipango ikiendelea kwa ajili ya udahili wa kundi la kwanza la wanafunzi mnamo Septemba 2026.
Metadata: Nyamira University College construction

English: The Cabinet Secretary also inspected the ongoing construction of a multi-storey tuition block at Nyamira Primary School before assessing the construction site for a nine-floor, 840-capacity student hostel at Kisii National Polytechnic.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri pia alikagua ujenzi unaoendelea wa jengo la masomo la ghorofa nyingi katika Shule ya Msingi ya Nyamira kabla ya kutathmini eneo la ujenzi wa hosteli ya wanafunzi yenye ghorofa tisa, yenye uwezo wa kuchukua wanafunzi 840 katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kitaifa cha Kisii.
Metadata: Nyamira/Kisii infrastructure inspection

English: He was accompanied by Hon. Steve Mogaka, MP for West Mugirango Constituency.
Kiswahili: Aliongozana na Mhe. Steve Mogaka, Mbunge wa Eneo Bunge la Mugirango Magharibi.
Metadata: Nyamira/Kisii infrastructure inspection

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, held a high-level meeting at TSC House in Upper Hill on the implementation of Chinese language education in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alifanya mkutano wa ngazi ya juu katika Jumba la TSC huko Upper Hill kuhusu utekelezaji wa elimu ya lugha ya Kichina nchini Kenya.
Metadata: Chinese language education programme

English: The engagement brought together key stakeholders, including Prof. Wang, on inclusion of Chinese language education in Kenya's Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC).
Kiswahili: Ushiriki huo uliwakutanisha wadau muhimu, akiwemo Prof. Wang, kuhusu ujumuishaji wa elimu ya lugha ya Kichina katika Mtaala wa Ustadi (CBC) wa Kenya.
Metadata: Chinese language education programme

English: Under the programme, teachers will undertake one year of training locally at the Confucius Institute and the University of Nairobi's Faculty of Education, culminating in a Postgraduate Diploma in Education (Chinese Language Track), before proceeding to Tianjin Normal University for a second year of advanced training.
Kiswahili: Chini ya mpango huo, walimu watachukua mwaka mmoja wa mafunzo katika Taasisi ya Confucius na Kitivo cha Elimu cha Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi, wakiishia katika Stashahada ya Uzamili katika Elimu (Kiingereza), kabla ya kuendelea na Chuo Kikuu cha Kawaida cha Tianjin kwa mwaka wa pili wa mafunzo ya juu.
Metadata: Chinese language education programme

English: Also in attendance was TSC Chairman Dr. Jamleck Muturi John and Acting CEO Evaleen Mitei.
Kiswahili: Pia waliohudhuria walikuwa Mwenyekiti wa TSC Dkt. Jamleck Muturi John na Kaimu Mkurugenzi Mtendaji Evaleen Mitei.
Metadata: Chinese language education programme

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency Simba Arati, Governor of Kisii County, and Hon. Japheth Nyakundi, MP for Kitutu Chache North, during a bursary disbursement ceremony held at Entanda School Grounds in Marani Sub-County, ensuring that learners from all backgrounds are able to complete their studies without interruption.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mheshimiwa Simba Arati, Gavana wa Kaunti ya Kisii, na Mheshimiwa Japheth Nyakundi, Mbunge wa Kitutu Chache Kaskazini, wakati wa sherehe ya utoaji wa misaada iliyofanyika katika Uwanja wa Shule ya Entanda katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Marani, kuhakikisha kwamba wanafunzi kutoka asili zote wanaweza kukamilisha masomo yao bila kukatizwa.
Metadata: Bursary disbursement, Kisii County

English: The leaders reaffirmed their commitment to strengthening partnerships between national and county governments in supporting education, noting that bursary programmes play a critical role in improving retention rates and enhancing academic performance among learners.
Kiswahili: Viongozi hao walithibitisha tena kujitolea kwao kuimarisha ushirikiano kati ya serikali za kitaifa na za kaunti katika kuunga mkono elimu, wakibainisha kuwa programu za ufadhili wa masomo zina jukumu muhimu katika kuboresha viwango vya wanafunzi kubaki shuleni na kuimarisha utendaji wa kitaaluma miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Metadata: Bursary disbursement, Kisii County

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, and Her Excellency Mama Rachel Ruto at the 64th Kenya National Drama and Film Festival State Concert held at State House, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, na Mheshimiwa Mama Rachel Ruto katika Tamasha la 64 la Kitaifa la Tamthilia na Filamu la Kenya lililofanyika katika Ikulu ya Nairobi.
Metadata: National Drama and Film Festival

English: The concert marked the climax of a twelve-day festival held from 6th to 17th April 2026 in Nyeri County, where students from all levels of learning across the country showcased exceptional imagination, creativity, and talent.
Kiswahili: Tamasha hilo liliashiria kilele cha tamasha la siku kumi na mbili lililofanyika kuanzia tarehe 6 hadi 17 Aprili 2026 katika Kaunti ya Nyeri, ambapo wanafunzi kutoka ngazi zote za kujifunza kote nchini walionyesha ubunifu, ubunifu, na vipaji vya kipekee.
Metadata: National Drama and Film Festival

English: The Government is committed to expanding access to higher education by increasing opportunities for education and training, in addition to providing funding.
Kiswahili: Serikali imejitolea kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu ya juu kwa kuongeza fursa za elimu na mafunzo, pamoja na kutoa ufadhili.
Metadata: African Talent University LIA

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, granted a Letter of Interim Authority to the African Talent University at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitoa Barua ya Mamlaka ya Muda kwa Chuo Kikuu cha Vipaji vya Kiafrika katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.
Metadata: African Talent University LIA

English: The Letter of Interim Authority enables the institution to train and award qualifications, while it works towards securing full accreditation.
Kiswahili: Barua ya Mamlaka ya Muda huiwezesha taasisi kutoa mafunzo na kutoa sifa, huku ikijitahidi kupata ithibati kamili.
Metadata: African Talent University LIA

English: The event was attended by, among others, the Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, and officials from the Commission for University Education and the African Talent University.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilihudhuriwa, miongoni mwa wengine, na Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, na maafisa kutoka Tume ya Elimu ya Vyuo Vikuu na Chuo Kikuu cha Vipaji vya Afrika.
Metadata: African Talent University LIA

English: The Ambassador of the Republic of Korea to Kenya, H.E. Kang Hyungshik, paid a courtesy call on the Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, at Jogoo House B.
Kiswahili: Balozi wa Jamhuri ya Korea nchini Kenya, Mhe. Kang Hyungshik, alimtembelea Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, katika Jumba la Jogoo B.
Metadata: Korea Ambassador courtesy call

English: Discussions focused on the evolving world of work driven by technology, modern training facilities, enhanced capacity development, and the establishment of a Career Development Unit.
Kiswahili: Majadiliano yalilenga ulimwengu unaobadilika wa kazi unaoendeshwa na teknolojia, vifaa vya kisasa vya mafunzo, ukuzaji wa uwezo ulioimarishwa, na uanzishwaji wa Kitengo cha Maendeleo ya Kazi.
Metadata: Korea Ambassador courtesy call

English: The Ambassador underscored the importance of sustained investment in education, technology, and research as key drivers of skills development.
Kiswahili: Balozi alisisitiza umuhimu wa uwekezaji endelevu katika elimu, teknolojia, na utafiti kama vichocheo muhimu vya ukuzaji wa ujuzi.
Metadata: Korea Ambassador courtesy call

English: Both parties expressed their commitment to strengthening the Korea-Kenya partnership to unlock further opportunities for innovation and skills development.
Kiswahili: Pande zote mbili zilielezea kujitolea kwao kuimarisha ushirikiano wa Korea na Kenya ili kufungua fursa zaidi za uvumbuzi na ukuzaji wa ujuzi.
Metadata: Korea Ambassador courtesy call

English: Education Cabinet Secretary Julius Migos Ogamba appeared before the National Assembly during a plenary session to respond to issues and questions raised by legislators regarding the state of the education sector in the country.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu Julius Migos Ogamba alifika mbele ya Bunge wakati wa kikao cha jumla kujibu masuala na maswali yaliyoulizwa na wabunge kuhusu hali ya sekta ya elimu nchini.
Metadata: National Assembly plenary session

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, visited Karatina University in Nyeri County to inspect ongoing infrastructure projects.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alitembelea Chuo Kikuu cha Karatina katika Kaunti ya Nyeri kukagua miradi ya miundombinu inayoendelea.
Metadata: Karatina University visit

English: The University has ongoing strategic partnerships with local and international universities to strengthen capacity in innovative pedagogy, while curricula are undergoing review to align with emerging demands.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu kina ushirikiano wa kimkakati unaoendelea na vyuo vikuu vya ndani na kimataifa ili kuimarisha uwezo katika ufundishaji bunifu, huku mitaala ikipitiwa upya ili kuendana na mahitaji yanayoibuka.
Metadata: Karatina University visit

English: Preparations for the first intake of Competency-Based Education (CBE) candidates in 2029 are on track.
Kiswahili: Maandalizi ya uandikishaji wa kwanza wa watahiniwa wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo (CBE) mwaka wa 2029 yanaendelea vizuri.
Metadata: Karatina University visit

English: During the visit, the Principal Secretary also engaged with both students and staff.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa ziara hiyo, Katibu Mkuu pia aliwasiliana na wanafunzi na wafanyakazi.
Metadata: Karatina University visit

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, visited Machakos University, where she toured the institution's facilities and engaged with university leadership to strengthen collaboration in research, innovation, and academic excellence.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alitembelea Chuo Kikuu cha Machakos, ambapo alitembelea vituo vya taasisi hiyo na kushirikiana na uongozi wa chuo kikuu ili kuimarisha ushirikiano katika utafiti, uvumbuzi, na ubora wa kitaaluma.
Metadata: Machakos University visit

English: The visit included an inspection of ongoing development projects, in line with preparations for the first intake of Competency-Based Education (CBE) candidates in 2029.
Kiswahili: Ziara hiyo ilijumuisha ukaguzi wa miradi ya maendeleo inayoendelea, sambamba na maandalizi ya uandikishaji wa kwanza wa wagombea wa Elimu Inayotegemea Umahiri (CBE) mwaka wa 2029.
Metadata: Machakos University visit

English: Partnerships with universities locally and internationally continue to drive capacity building in innovative pedagogy, as curricula undergo review.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano na vyuo vikuu vya ndani na kimataifa unaendelea kuchochea ujenzi wa uwezo katika ufundishaji bunifu, huku mitaala ikipitiwa.
Metadata: Machakos University visit

English: She was accompanied, among others, by the Vice-Chancellor of Chuka University, Prof. Henry Mutembei; the Chief Executive Officer of HELB, Geoffrey Monari; and the CEO of the University Fund (UF), Dr. Edwin Wanyonyi.
Kiswahili: Aliandamana, miongoni mwa wengine, na Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Chuka, Prof. Henry Mutembei; Afisa Mkuu Mtendaji wa HELB, Geoffrey Monari; na Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Mfuko wa Chuo Kikuu (UF), Dkt. Edwin Wanyonyi.
Metadata: Machakos University visit

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, graced the closing ceremony of the Kenya Association of Technical Training Institutions Leadership Engagement and Capacity Building Workshop, held at PrideInn Paradise Beach Resort, Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria sherehe ya kufunga warsha ya Ushirikishwaji wa Uongozi na Ujenzi wa Uwezo wa Chama cha Taasisi za Mafunzo ya Ufundi nchini Kenya, iliyofanyika katika Hoteli ya PrideInn Paradise Beach, Mombasa.
Metadata: KATTI Leadership Workshop

English: The three-day workshop brought together leaders from technical and vocational training institutions across the country to deliberate on strategies for strengthening governance, enhancing institutional leadership, and aligning training with industry needs.
Kiswahili: Warsha hiyo ya siku tatu iliwakutanisha viongozi kutoka taasisi za mafunzo ya ufundi na ufundi kote nchini ili kujadili mikakati ya kuimarisha utawala, kuimarisha uongozi wa taasisi, na kuoanisha mafunzo na mahitaji ya sekta.
Metadata: KATTI Leadership Workshop

English: Effective governance and leadership is critical to fostering an environment that facilitates quality education and training and gives effect to the transformative reforms the Government is rolling out in the TVET sub-sector.
Kiswahili: Utawala na uongozi bora ni muhimu katika kukuza mazingira yanayowezesha elimu na mafunzo bora na kutoa athari kwa mageuzi ya mabadiliko ambayo Serikali inayaanzisha katika sekta ndogo ya TVET.
Metadata: KATTI Leadership Workshop

English: The event was also graced by the Principal Secretary for TVET, Dr. Esther Muoria.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo pia ilihudhuriwa na Katibu Mkuu wa TVET, Dkt. Esther Muoria.
Metadata: KATTI Leadership Workshop

English: The approved capitation for primary school is capped at Ksh 1,400 per year, with funds usually released by the National Treasury to the Ministry of Education on a termly basis in the ratio of 50:30:20.
Kiswahili: Kiwango cha wanafunzi walioidhinishwa kwa shule ya msingi kimewekewa kikomo cha shilingi 1,400 kwa mwaka, huku fedha kwa kawaida zikitolewa na Hazina ya Kitaifa kwa Wizara ya Elimu kwa muhula wa 50:30:20.
Metadata: Primary school capitation circular

English: The capitation amount is arrived at based on clear expenditure lines (vote heads) determined by estimated costs incurred by each learner.
Kiswahili: Kiasi cha mwanafunzi hufikiwa kulingana na mistari ya matumizi iliyo wazi (vichwa vya kura) vinavyoamuliwa na gharama zinazokadiriwa zilizotumika na kila mwanafunzi.
Metadata: Primary school capitation circular

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, graced the 6th Graduation Ceremony of Kisii National Polytechnic, where 4,213 graduands were awarded diplomas and certificates across various fields.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria sherehe ya kuhitimu ya 6 ya Chuo Kikuu cha Kitaifa cha Kisii, ambapo wahitimu 4,213 walitunukiwa diploma na vyeti katika nyanja mbalimbali.
Metadata: Kisii National Polytechnic graduation

English: The ceremony underscored the critical role of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) in equipping young people with practical skills, fostering innovation, and preparing a competent workforce to drive the country's industrial growth and economic transformation.
Kiswahili: Sherehe hiyo ilisisitiza jukumu muhimu la Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi (TVET) katika kuwapa vijana ujuzi wa vitendo, kukuza uvumbuzi, na kuandaa nguvu kazi yenye uwezo wa kuendesha ukuaji wa viwanda na mabadiliko ya kiuchumi nchini.
Metadata: Kisii National Polytechnic graduation

English: Also present was H.E. Elijah Obebo, Deputy Governor of Kisii County.
Kiswahili: Pia alikuwepo Mheshimiwa Elijah Obebo, Naibu Gavana wa Kaunti ya Kisii.
Metadata: Kisii National Polytechnic graduation

English: The Principal Secretary, State Department for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, appeared before the Public Accounts Committee to review the Auditor-General's Report on the Financial Statements for FY 2023/2024.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu, Idara ya Jimbo la Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alifika mbele ya Kamati ya Hesabu za Umma ili kupitia Ripoti ya Mkaguzi Mkuu wa Hesabu za Fedha kwa mwaka wa fedha wa 2023/2024.
Metadata: Public Accounts Committee session

English: The session provided an opportunity to reaffirm the Department's commitment to accountability, transparency, and the prudent use of public resources in the higher education sector.
Kiswahili: Kikao hicho kilitoa fursa ya kuthibitisha tena kujitolea kwa Idara katika uwajibikaji, uwazi, na matumizi ya busara ya rasilimali za umma katika sekta ya elimu ya juu.
Metadata: Public Accounts Committee session

English: The Principal Secretary was accompanied by the Acting CEO of the University Fund (UF) and the Vice-Chancellor of Co-operative University, among others.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu aliambatana na Kaimu Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Mfuko wa Chuo Kikuu (UF) na Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Ushirika, miongoni mwa wengine.
Metadata: Public Accounts Committee session

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, presided over the official opening of the 3rd Annual Educational Assessment Symposium at the New Mitihani House in South C.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, aliongoza ufunguzi rasmi wa Kongamano la Tathmini ya Elimu la Mwaka la 3 katika Jumba Jipya la Mitihani huko South C.
Metadata: Educational Assessment Symposium

English: This year's Symposium was held under the theme Reimagining Curriculum, Pedagogy and Assessment for Inclusive, Innovative and Future-Ready Learning.
Kiswahili: Kongamano la mwaka huu lilifanyika chini ya mada ya Kufikiria Upya Mtaala, Ufundishaji na Tathmini kwa ajili ya Kujifunza Jumuishi, Bunifu na Tayari kwa Wakati Ujao.
Metadata: Educational Assessment Symposium

English: The Symposium provides a platform for structured reflection and strategic conversation on how to better align curriculum, pedagogy, and assessment.
Kiswahili: Kongamano hili hutoa jukwaa la tafakari iliyopangwa na mazungumzo ya kimkakati kuhusu jinsi ya kuoanisha vyema mtaala, ufundishaji, na tathmini.
Metadata: Educational Assessment Symposium

English: The event was graced by, among others, the Principal Secretary for Basic Education, Amb. Prof. Julius Bitok.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilihudhuriwa na, miongoni mwa wengine, Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Msingi, Balozi Profesa Julius Bitok.
Metadata: Educational Assessment Symposium

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, in the company of the Secretary to the Cabinet, Mrs. Mercy Wanjau, met with a team of researchers under the Advancing Women's Leadership in Academia initiative.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, pamoja na Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri, Bi. Mercy Wanjau, walikutana na timu ya watafiti chini ya mpango wa Kuendeleza Uongozi wa Wanawake katika Taaluma.
Metadata: Women's Leadership in Academia

English: The team presented findings of research on the challenges facing women's leadership in academia, and proposed interventions to ensure women are not unduly prevented from ascending to leadership roles.
Kiswahili: Timu hiyo iliwasilisha matokeo ya utafiti kuhusu changamoto zinazowakabili uongozi wa wanawake katika taaluma, na ilipendekeza hatua za kuchukua ili kuhakikisha wanawake hawazuiliwi kupita kiasi kupanda nafasi za uongozi.
Metadata: Women's Leadership in Academia

English: The Ministry of Education is committed to fostering an environment of equality of genders and open competition for leadership in academia, in line with the tenets of the Constitution.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imejitolea kukuza mazingira ya usawa wa kijinsia na ushindani wazi wa uongozi katika taaluma, kulingana na kanuni za Katiba.
Metadata: Women's Leadership in Academia

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, attended the 2nd National Education Conference officially opened by His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, at the Lake Naivasha Resort in Naivasha, Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria Kongamano la 2 la Kitaifa la Elimu lililofunguliwa rasmi na Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, katika hoteli ya Lake Naivasha huko Naivasha, Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Metadata: 2nd National Education Conference

English: The Conference brought together associations, learners and faith-based organizations spanning the entire education continuum.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo ulileta pamoja vyama, wanafunzi na mashirika ya kidini yanayojumuisha mwendelezo mzima wa elimu.
Metadata: 2nd National Education Conference

English: The Conference was convened to review progress made, especially in the rollout of Competency-Based Education, and to examine transformative reforms being implemented to ensure the education system remains fit for purpose in the 21st century.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo uliitishwa ili kupitia maendeleo yaliyopatikana, hasa katika utekelezaji wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo, na kuchunguza mageuzi yanayoleta mabadiliko yanayotekelezwa ili kuhakikisha mfumo wa elimu unabaki unafaa kwa madhumuni katika karne ya 21.
Metadata: 2nd National Education Conference

English: The event was attended by, among others, the Principal Secretaries for Basic Education (Amb. Julius K. Bitok) and Higher Education (Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala).
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo ilihudhuriwa, miongoni mwa wengine, Makatibu Wakuu wa Elimu ya Msingi (Mb. Julius K. Bitok) na Elimu ya Juu (Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala).
Metadata: 2nd National Education Conference

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, conveyed a message of condolence from His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, to the family of the late Prof. Raphael Munavu.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alituma ujumbe wa rambirambi kutoka kwa Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, kwa familia ya marehemu Profesa Raphael Munavu.
Metadata: Condolence message, Prof. Raphael Munavu

English: The late Prof. Munavu, a reform leader whose work left an indelible mark, most recently served as Chairperson of the Presidential Working Party on Education Reform.
Kiswahili: Marehemu Profesa Munavu, kiongozi wa mageuzi ambaye kazi yake iliacha alama isiyofutika, hivi karibuni alihudumu kama Mwenyekiti wa Chama cha Rais cha Mageuzi ya Elimu.
Metadata: Condolence message, Prof. Raphael Munavu

English: The recommendations of the Working Party continue to shape the implementation of Competency-Based Education.
Kiswahili: Mapendekezo ya Chama Kazi yanaendelea kuunda utekelezaji wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo.
Metadata: Condolence message, Prof. Raphael Munavu

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, joined the Deputy President, Kithure Kindiki, in officially opening the 3rd Annual Regulatory Authorities and Agencies Conference at the South Eastern Kenya University Main Campus.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alijiunga na Naibu Rais, Kithure Kindiki, katika kufungua rasmi Mkutano wa 3 wa Mwaka wa Mamlaka na Mashirika ya Udhibiti katika Kampasi Kuu ya Chuo Kikuu cha Kusini Mashariki mwa Kenya.
Metadata: Regulatory Authorities and Agencies Conference

English: The Conference aims to shape markets, safeguard livelihoods, and protect the welfare of all Kenyans in line with the Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda (BETA).
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo unalenga kuunda masoko, kulinda riziki, na kulinda ustawi wa Wakenya wote kulingana na Ajenda ya Mabadiliko ya Kiuchumi ya Chini-Kupanda (BETA).
Metadata: Regulatory Authorities and Agencies Conference

English: Other dignitaries present included the Head of Public Service, Felix Koskei, fellow Principal Secretaries, chairpersons and board members of regulatory authorities, and Chief Executive Officers of agencies.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wengine mashuhuri waliohudhuria ni pamoja na Mkuu wa Utumishi wa Umma, Felix Koskei, Makatibu Wakuu wenzake, wenyeviti na wajumbe wa bodi za mamlaka za udhibiti, na Maafisa Wakuu wa Mashirika.
Metadata: Regulatory Authorities and Agencies Conference

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, at Maseno School in Kisumu County to celebrate the 120th Anniversary of the establishment of the institution.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, katika Shule ya Maseno katika Kaunti ya Kisumu kusherehekea miaka 120 ya kuanzishwa kwa taasisi hiyo.
Metadata: Maseno School 120th anniversary

English: Established in 1906 with only six learners, Maseno School has grown into one of the country's most distinguished institutions of learning, widely respected for its tradition of academic excellence, character formation, and leadership development.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Maseno, iliyoanzishwa mwaka wa 1906 ikiwa na wanafunzi sita pekee, imekua na kuwa mojawapo ya taasisi maarufu za kujifunza nchini, ikiheshimiwa sana kwa utamaduni wake wa ubora wa kitaaluma, malezi ya tabia, na maendeleo ya uongozi.
Metadata: Maseno School 120th anniversary

English: Over the past 120 years, the school has nurtured generations of leaders who have made notable contributions to national development, firmly securing its place among Kenya's enduring centres of educational excellence.
Kiswahili: Katika kipindi cha miaka 120 iliyopita, shule hiyo imewalea vizazi vya viongozi ambao wametoa michango muhimu kwa maendeleo ya taifa, na hivyo kuilinda vyema nafasi yake miongoni mwa vituo vya kudumu vya ubora wa elimu nchini Kenya.
Metadata: Maseno School 120th anniversary

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alongside the Principal Secretary for the State Department for TVET, Esther Mworia, officiated the opening of the 1st National Qualifications Conference organised by the Kenya National Qualifications Authority.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, pamoja na Katibu Mkuu wa Idara ya Mambo ya Nje ya TVET, Esther Mworia, waliongoza ufunguzi wa Mkutano wa Kwanza wa Kitaifa wa Sifa ulioandaliwa na Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Sifa ya Kenya.
Metadata: National Qualifications Conference

English: The Conference brought together stakeholders from government, industry, civil society, employers, conformity assessment bodies, and regulatory agencies, united in advancing Kenya's qualifications and skills agenda.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo uliwaleta pamoja wadau kutoka serikalini, viwandani, asasi za kiraia, waajiri, vyombo vya tathmini ya ulinganifu, na mashirika ya udhibiti, kwa pamoja katika kuendeleza ajenda ya sifa na ujuzi ya Kenya.
Metadata: National Qualifications Conference

English: The event highlighted the dignity of labour, the need to unlock human potential, recognise competencies wherever they are found, and build a globally competitive education system.
Kiswahili: Tukio hilo liliangazia heshima ya kazi, hitaji la kufungua uwezo wa binadamu, kutambua uwezo popote ulipo, na kujenga mfumo wa elimu wenye ushindani wa kimataifa.
Metadata: National Qualifications Conference

English: Also in attendance was the Principal Secretary for the State Department for Industrialization, Dr. Juma Mukhwana.
Kiswahili: Pia aliyehudhuria alikuwa Katibu Mkuu wa Idara ya Nchi ya Viwanda, Dkt. Juma Mukhwana.
Metadata: National Qualifications Conference

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, hosted the Governor of Samburu County, Hon. Lati Lelelit, the Chair of the Laikipia University Council, Dr. Lemein Korei, and the Vice-Chancellor of Laikipia University, Prof. Kibett Rotich, at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alimkaribisha Gavana wa Kaunti ya Samburu, Mheshimiwa Lati Lelelit, Mwenyekiti wa Baraza la Chuo Kikuu cha Laikipia, Dkt. Lemein Korei, na Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Laikipia, Prof. Kibett Rotich, katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.
Metadata: Samburu University establishment

English: The meeting discussed the implementation of the directive by His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, on the establishment of a university in Samburu County.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo ulijadili utekelezaji wa agizo la Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, kuhusu kuanzishwa kwa chuo kikuu katika Kaunti ya Samburu.
Metadata: Samburu University establishment

English: The Government is committed to expanding access to higher education through multiple strategies, including establishing universities across the country and ensuring university programmes remain affordable and equitably funded.
Kiswahili: Serikali imejitolea kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu ya juu kupitia mikakati mingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuanzisha vyuo vikuu kote nchini na kuhakikisha programu za vyuo vikuu zinabaki kuwa nafuu na zinafadhiliwa kwa usawa.
Metadata: Samburu University establishment

English: The Government is implementing a deliberate effort to balance broad access to higher education with targeted centres of excellence that advance the country's strategic development priorities.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatekeleza juhudi za makusudi za kusawazisha upatikanaji mpana wa elimu ya juu na vituo lengwa vya ubora vinavyolenga kuendeleza vipaumbele vya maendeleo ya kimkakati vya nchi.
Metadata: Kenya-AIST conferment

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, was honoured with a conferment at Kenya-AIST, marking institutions with highly specialized mandates focused on training and advanced research in fields critical to Kenya's future competitiveness.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitunukiwa tuzo katika Kenya-AIST, akiashiria taasisi zenye mamlaka maalum ya juu zinazolenga mafunzo na utafiti wa hali ya juu katika nyanja muhimu kwa ushindani wa Kenya katika siku zijazo.
Metadata: Kenya-AIST conferment

English: The event was also graced by the Cabinet Secretary for Health, Hon. Aden Duale, and the Cabinet Secretary for Information, Communications and the Digital Economy, Hon. William Kabogo Gitau.
Kiswahili: Hafla hiyo pia ilihudhuriwa na Waziri wa Afya, Mhe. Aden Duale, na Katibu wa Habari, Mawasiliano na Uchumi wa Kidijitali, Mhe. William Kabogo Gitau.
Metadata: Kenya-AIST conferment

English: The Government is working together with other stakeholders, including faith-based organizations and sponsors, to enhance access to education through improving infrastructure and facilities.
Kiswahili: Serikali inashirikiana na wadau wengine, ikiwa ni pamoja na mashirika ya kidini na wafadhili, ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa elimu kupitia kuboresha miundombinu na vifaa.
Metadata: Fr. Makewa High School visit

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, visited Fr. Makewa High School, which has successfully sent over 2,000 students to university and more to other institutions of tertiary education.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitembelea Shule ya Upili ya Fr. Makewa, ambayo imefanikiwa kupeleka zaidi ya wanafunzi 2,000 chuo kikuu na zaidi katika taasisi zingine za elimu ya juu.
Metadata: Fr. Makewa High School visit

English: This achievement demonstrates the significant impact that collaboration between the Government and other stakeholders can have on educational outcomes at both the local and national levels.
Kiswahili: Mafanikio haya yanaonyesha athari kubwa ambayo ushirikiano kati ya Serikali na wadau wengine unaweza kuwa nayo kwenye matokeo ya kielimu katika ngazi za mitaa na kitaifa.
Metadata: Fr. Makewa High School visit

English: The investment in modern learning infrastructure reflects the Ministry's broader commitment to nurturing human capital, expanding access to quality education, and equipping learners with the skills and competencies necessary to thrive in an evolving global economy.
Kiswahili: Uwekezaji katika miundombinu ya kisasa ya kujifunza unaonyesha dhamira pana ya Wizara ya kukuza rasilimali watu, kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu bora, na kuwapa wanafunzi ujuzi na uwezo unaohitajika ili kustawi katika uchumi wa dunia unaobadilika.
Metadata: School infrastructure investment

English: Mr. Nelson Sifuna, Head of the Directorate of Field Coordination and Co-curricular Activities, led an inspection of the refurbishment of 10 classrooms and construction of 2 new classrooms at Waberi Primary School in Wajir County ahead of the Madaraka Day celebrations.
Kiswahili: Bw. Nelson Sifuna, Mkuu wa Kurugenzi ya Uratibu wa Ugani na Shughuli za Pamoja za Shule, aliongoza ukaguzi wa ukarabati wa madarasa 10 na ujenzi wa madarasa 2 mapya katika Shule ya Msingi ya Waberi katika Kaunti ya Wajir kabla ya sherehe za Siku ya Madaraka.
Metadata: Waberi Primary School inspection, Wajir

English: The Director-General, Dr. Elyas Abdi, led a meeting with field officers from the Ministry of Education and TSC in Wajir County to assess preparedness for the upcoming Madaraka Day celebrations themed Education, Skills and the Future.
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mkuu, Dkt. Elyas Abdi, aliongoza mkutano na maafisa wa uwanjani kutoka Wizara ya Elimu na TSC katika Kaunti ya Wajir ili kutathmini maandalizi ya sherehe zijazo za Siku ya Madaraka zenye mada ya Elimu, Ujuzi na Mustakabali.
Metadata: Madaraka Day preparations, Wajir

English: The four-day programme will feature discussions on policy, innovation, leadership, skills development and community-based learning as the Ministry continues to advance transformative and inclusive education initiatives across the country.
Kiswahili: Programu hiyo ya siku nne itaangazia mijadala kuhusu sera, uvumbuzi, uongozi, ukuzaji wa ujuzi na ujifunzaji unaozingatia jamii huku Wizara ikiendelea kuendeleza mipango ya elimu yenye mabadiliko na jumuishi kote nchini.
Metadata: Madaraka Day preparations, Wajir

English: The Government is making strategic investments in teacher education and training, recognizing their critical role in preparing human capital for Competency-Based Education (CBE).
Kiswahili: Serikali inafanya uwekezaji wa kimkakati katika elimu na mafunzo ya walimu, ikitambua jukumu lao muhimu katika kuandaa rasilimali watu kwa ajili ya Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo (CBE).
Metadata: Garsen Teachers College groundbreaking

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency President Dr. William Samoei Ruto at the groundbreaking ceremony for Garsen Teachers College in Tana River County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Rais Mtukufu Dkt. William Samoei Ruto katika sherehe ya uzinduzi wa Chuo cha Walimu cha Garsen katika Kaunti ya Tana River.
Metadata: Garsen Teachers College groundbreaking

English: The institution is expected to strengthen teacher education and expand access to quality education within the region and beyond.
Kiswahili: Taasisi hiyo inatarajiwa kuimarisha elimu ya walimu na kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu bora ndani ya eneo hilo na kwingineko.
Metadata: Garsen Teachers College groundbreaking

English: Earlier, the Cabinet Secretary visited Pwani University in Kilifi County ahead of the President's scheduled visit for the groundbreaking of student hostels, part of the Government's broader efforts to expand access to higher education through infrastructure development and improved affordability.
Kiswahili: Hapo awali, Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri alitembelea Chuo Kikuu cha Pwani katika Kaunti ya Kilifi kabla ya ziara iliyopangwa ya Rais kwa ajili ya ujenzi wa hosteli za wanafunzi, sehemu ya juhudi pana za Serikali za kupanua upatikanaji wa elimu ya juu kupitia maendeleo ya miundombinu na kuboresha uwezo wa kumudu gharama.
Metadata: Pwani University hostel groundbreaking

English: Expanding infrastructure in our educational institutions is a key strategy towards promoting equitable access to higher education.
Kiswahili: Kupanua miundombinu katika taasisi zetu za elimu ni mkakati muhimu wa kukuza upatikanaji sawa wa elimu ya juu.
Metadata: Pwani University hostel groundbreaking

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined His Excellency the President, Dr. William Samoei Ruto, at the groundbreaking ceremony for student hostels at Pwani University.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mheshimiwa Rais, Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, katika sherehe ya uzinduzi wa hosteli za wanafunzi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Pwani.
Metadata: Pwani University hostel groundbreaking

English: The project will increase the accommodation capacity at Pwani University, thereby lowering costs and promoting student convenience as they pursue their studies.
Kiswahili: Mradi huo utaongeza uwezo wa malazi katika Chuo Kikuu cha Pwani, na hivyo kupunguza gharama na kukuza urahisi wa wanafunzi wanapoendelea na masomo yao.
Metadata: Pwani University hostel groundbreaking

English: Nikkita, a law student at Kabarak University, said HELB support has eased the financial burden on her family and allowed her to focus fully on her demanding law studies without constant financial stress.
Kiswahili: Nikkita, mwanafunzi wa sheria katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kabarak, alisema usaidizi wa HELB umepunguza mzigo wa kifedha kwa familia yake na kumruhusu kuzingatia kikamilifu masomo yake ya sheria yenye mahitaji bila msongo wa kifedha wa mara kwa mara.
Metadata: HELB student testimonial (via TUKO.co.ke)

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, graced the Nyandarua High School Prize Giving Day in Nyandarua County.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria Siku ya Kutoa Tuzo za Shule ya Upili ya Nyandarua katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua.
Metadata: Nyandarua High School Prize Giving Day

English: Nyandarua High School, a mixed, national-level institution, is among the country's top-performing schools, with a rich history of academic and co-curricular performance.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Nyandarua, taasisi mchanganyiko ya kitaifa, ni miongoni mwa shule zinazofanya vizuri zaidi nchini, zenye historia tajiri ya utendaji wa kitaaluma na wa pamoja wa masomo.
Metadata: Nyandarua High School Prize Giving Day

English: Other leaders in attendance were the Cabinet Secretary for Tourism and Wildlife, Rebecca Miano, and the Principal Secretary for Roads, Eng. Joseph Mbugua.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wengine waliohudhuria walikuwa Waziri wa Utalii na Wanyamapori, Rebecca Miano, na Katibu Mkuu wa Barabara, Mhandisi Joseph Mbugua.
Metadata: Nyandarua High School Prize Giving Day

English: The Government continues to take steps and measures to promote the welfare of teachers, including increasing teacher numbers to rationalize workloads, with a record 100,000 teachers employed in the last three years.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaendelea kuchukua hatua na hatua za kukuza ustawi wa walimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na kuongeza idadi ya walimu ili kuhalalisha mzigo wa kazi, huku rekodi ikiwa na walimu 100,000 walioajiriwa katika miaka mitatu iliyopita.
Metadata: Teacher welfare, KNUT engagement

English: This has facilitated career progression and created an enabling environment for teacher performance.
Kiswahili: Hii imewezesha maendeleo ya kazi na kuunda mazingira wezeshi kwa utendaji wa walimu.
Metadata: Teacher welfare, KNUT engagement

English: Our education thrives because of our teachers, who teach and inspire millions of learners in our educational institutions.
Kiswahili: Elimu yetu inastawi kwa sababu ya walimu wetu, ambao hufundisha na kuwatia moyo mamilioni ya wanafunzi katika taasisi zetu za elimu.
Metadata: Teacher appreciation message

English: Teachers are the primary custodians of the resources and investments made in the education sector.
Kiswahili: Walimu ndio walinzi wakuu wa rasilimali na uwekezaji unaofanywa katika sekta ya elimu.
Metadata: Teacher appreciation message

English: Higher education is about creating opportunities and making education work better for every student; the Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Inyangala, explained how the Student-Centred Funding Model works, the changes made through student feedback, and what this means for learners.
Kiswahili: Elimu ya juu inahusu kuunda fursa na kufanya elimu ifanye kazi vizuri zaidi kwa kila mwanafunzi; Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Inyangala, alielezea jinsi Mfumo wa Ufadhili Unaozingatia Wanafunzi unavyofanya kazi, mabadiliko yanayofanywa kupitia maoni ya wanafunzi, na maana yake kwa wanafunzi.
Metadata: Student-Centred Funding Model explainer

English: Following the Utumishi Girls fire tragedy, the Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Ogamba, announced hotline number 1199 for parents to report information, especially those who left with their children when they came earlier, with the line also available for counselling.
Kiswahili: Kufuatia mkasa wa moto wa Utumishi Girls, Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Ogamba, alitangaza nambari ya simu 1199 kwa wazazi kuripoti taarifa, hasa wale walioondoka na watoto wao walipokuja mapema, huku simu hiyo pia ikipatikana kwa ajili ya ushauri nasaha.
Metadata: Utumishi Girls fire tragedy hotline

English: The Madaraka Day Thematic Session Three, themed Education in Future: Shaping the Future through Education, Innovations and Opportunities, was held on 30 May 2026 at Wagberi Primary School.
Kiswahili: Kipindi cha Tatu cha Mada ya Siku ya Madaraka, chenye mada kuu Elimu katika Wakati Ujao: Kuunda Wakati Ujao Kupitia Elimu, Ubunifu na Fursa, kilifanyika tarehe 30 Mei 2026 katika Shule ya Msingi ya Wagberi.
Metadata: Madaraka Day Thematic Session Three

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, served as guest of honour, alongside vice-chancellors and university panelists from institutions including South Eastern Kenya University, Eldoret, Meru, MMUST, and Bomet.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alihudumu kama mgeni wa heshima, pamoja na makamu wa machansela na wanajopo wa vyuo vikuu kutoka taasisi zikiwemo Chuo Kikuu cha Kusini Mashariki mwa Kenya, Eldoret, Meru, MMUST, na Bomet.
Metadata: Madaraka Day Thematic Session Three

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, toured Wajir High School, the oldest secondary school in Kenya's North Eastern Region.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alitembelea Shule ya Upili ya Wajir, shule ya upili kongwe zaidi katika Mkoa wa Kaskazini Mashariki mwa Kenya.
Metadata: Wajir High School tour

English: During the visit, he commended the school for its long-standing contribution to education in the region, noting its role in nurturing generations of learners and producing distinguished alumni.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa ziara hiyo, aliipongeza shule hiyo kwa mchango wake wa muda mrefu katika elimu katika eneo hilo, akibainisha jukumu lake katika kulea vizazi vya wanafunzi na kutoa wahitimu mashuhuri.
Metadata: Wajir High School tour

English: He urged the school community to maintain its commitment to academic excellence and discipline as it continues to shape future leaders.
Kiswahili: Aliwahimiza jamii ya shule kudumisha kujitolea kwake kwa ubora wa kitaaluma na nidhamu huku ikiendelea kuwaunda viongozi wa siku zijazo.
Metadata: Wajir High School tour

English: As Kenya celebrated its 63rd Madaraka Day, the Ministry noted that through TVET, youths and Kenyans at large are acquiring competencies to create, innovate, compete, drive industrial growth, and transform communities, under the theme Education, Skills and the Future - One Competence at a Time.
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikisherehekea Siku yake ya 63 ya Madaraka, Wizara ilibainisha kuwa kupitia TVET, vijana na Wakenya kwa ujumla wanapata ujuzi wa kuunda, kuvumbua, kushindana, kuendesha ukuaji wa viwanda, na kubadilisha jamii, chini ya mada Elimu, Ujuzi na Mustakabali - Uwezo Mmoja kwa Wakati.
Metadata: Madaraka Day, TVET message

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, attended official bilateral discussions between Kenya and South Africa, under the joint chairmanship of President Dr. William Samoei Ruto and President Cyril Ramaphosa, covering cooperation, sports and culture, as well as gender equality and women empowerment.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria mijadala rasmi ya pande mbili kati ya Kenya na Afrika Kusini, chini ya uenyekiti wa pamoja wa Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto na Rais Cyril Ramaphosa, ikizungumzia ushirikiano, michezo na utamaduni, pamoja na usawa wa kijinsia na uwezeshaji wa wanawake.
Metadata: Kenya-South Africa bilateral discussions

English: The Cabinet Secretary signed a Memorandum of Understanding for Cooperation in the Field of Technical and Vocational Education and Training between Kenya and South Africa.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri alisaini Mkataba wa Makubaliano ya Ushirikiano katika Nyanja ya Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi kati ya Kenya na Afrika Kusini.
Metadata: Kenya-South Africa TVET MOU

English: The MoU provides a platform for Kenya and South Africa to reset and deepen cooperation in the TVET sector through sharing best practices, undertaking joint research, and implementing staff and student exchanges.
Kiswahili: MoU hutoa jukwaa kwa Kenya na Afrika Kusini kuanzisha upya na kuimarisha ushirikiano katika sekta ya TVET kupitia kushiriki mbinu bora, kufanya utafiti wa pamoja, na kutekeleza ubadilishanaji wa wafanyakazi na wanafunzi.
Metadata: Kenya-South Africa TVET MOU

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, attended the Presidential Session of the Kenya-South Africa Business Forum in Midrand, South Africa, under the patronage of President Dr. William Samoei Ruto and President Cyril Ramaphosa.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alihudhuria Kikao cha Rais cha Jukwaa la Biashara la Kenya-Afrika Kusini huko Midrand, Afrika Kusini, chini ya ufadhili wa Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto na Rais Cyril Ramaphosa.
Metadata: Kenya-South Africa Business Forum

English: The Forum brought together Government officials and business leaders to reflect on the state of trade between the two countries and deliberate on strategies for enhancing bilateral and regional trade.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa hilo liliwakutanisha maafisa wa Serikali na viongozi wa biashara ili kutafakari hali ya biashara kati ya nchi hizo mbili na kujadili mikakati ya kuimarisha biashara ya pande mbili na ya kikanda.
Metadata: Kenya-South Africa Business Forum

English: Regional integration is key to promoting intra-African trade to unlock massive market potential across sectors, including in education and related services.
Kiswahili: Ujumuishaji wa kikanda ni muhimu katika kukuza biashara ya ndani ya Afrika ili kufungua uwezo mkubwa wa soko katika sekta mbalimbali, ikiwa ni pamoja na elimu na huduma zinazohusiana.
Metadata: Kenya-South Africa Business Forum

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, accompanied by the Principal Secretaries for Basic Education, TVET, and Higher Education, briefed the Deputy President, Prof. Kithure Kindiki, on education sector issues.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, akifuatana na Makatibu Wakuu wa Elimu ya Msingi, TVET, na Elimu ya Juu, walimpa taarifa Naibu Rais, Prof. Kithure Kindiki, kuhusu masuala ya sekta ya elimu.
Metadata: Deputy President education briefing

English: The meeting deliberated matters of school safety and security, the rollout of Competency-Based Education, and the promotion of access and equity at all levels of education.
Kiswahili: Mkutano huo ulijadili masuala ya usalama na usalama wa shule, utekelezaji wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo, na uendelezaji wa upatikanaji na usawa katika ngazi zote za elimu.
Metadata: Deputy President education briefing

English: Team Kenya secured its first-ever Grand Prize in the Huawei ICT Competition 2025-2026 Global Final in Shenzhen, China.
Kiswahili: Timu ya Kenya ilipata Tuzo yake Kuu ya kwanza kabisa katika Fainali ya Kimataifa ya Huawei ICT 2025-2026 huko Shenzhen, China.
Metadata: Huawei ICT Competition win

English: This win inspires confidence in the future of Kenya's tech-driven economy and confirms the global competitiveness of Kenya's education and training system.
Kiswahili: Ushindi huu unatia moyo kujiamini katika mustakabali wa uchumi wa Kenya unaoendeshwa na teknolojia na unathibitisha ushindani wa kimataifa wa mfumo wa elimu na mafunzo wa Kenya.
Metadata: Huawei ICT Competition win

English: Competitions such as the Huawei ICT competition provide a critical platform promoting skilling in technology in Kenya and the world, and demonstrate trainees' and students' preparedness for the world of work.
Kiswahili: Mashindano kama vile shindano la TEHAMA la Huawei hutoa jukwaa muhimu la kukuza ujuzi katika teknolojia nchini Kenya na duniani kote, na kuonyesha utayari wa wanafunzi na wanafunzi kwa ulimwengu wa kazi.
Metadata: Huawei ICT Competition win

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, hosted the incoming Principal Secretary for Basic Education, John Lekakeny Ololtuaa, and the outgoing Principal Secretary, Amb. Prof. Julius Bitok, at the Ministry's Jogoo House B offices.
Kiswahili: Katibu wa Baraza la Mawaziri la Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alimkaribisha Katibu Mkuu mpya wa Elimu ya Msingi, John Lekakeny Ololtuaa, na Katibu Mkuu anayemaliza muda wake, Balozi Profesa Julius Bitok, katika ofisi za Jogoo House B za Wizara.
Metadata: Basic Education PS handover

English: The Cabinet Secretary welcomed John Lekakeny Ololtuaa to the Ministry of Education and wished Prof. Julius Bitok every success in his new role.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Baraza la Mawaziri alimkaribisha John Lekakeny Ololtuaa katika Wizara ya Elimu na kumtakia Profesa Julius Bitok kila la heri katika nafasi yake mpya.
Metadata: Basic Education PS handover

English: The FY 2026-27 Mwananchi Budget Guide allocates Ksh 61.6 billion for Free Primary and Day Secondary Education, and Ksh 38.9 billion for Junior Secondary School Capitation.
Kiswahili: Mwongozo wa Bajeti ya Mwananchi wa Mwaka wa Fedha wa 2026-27 unatenga Ksh bilioni 61.6 kwa ajili ya Elimu ya Msingi na Sekondari ya Kutwa Bila Malipo, na Ksh bilioni 38.9 kwa ajili ya Kujifunza Shule za Sekondari za Watoto Wadogo.
Metadata: FY2026-27 Budget Highlights

English: The budget also provides Ksh 8.2 billion for Intern Teachers, Ksh 7.3 billion for Technical Vocational Education Training, and Ksh 7.1 billion for the Kenya Primary Education Equity in Learning programme.
Kiswahili: Bajeti hiyo pia inatoa Ksh bilioni 8.2 kwa Walimu wa Mafunzo ya Ndani, Ksh bilioni 7.3 kwa Mafunzo ya Elimu ya Ufundi Stadi, na Ksh bilioni 7.1 kwa programu ya Usawa katika Kujifunza ya Elimu ya Msingi ya Kenya.
Metadata: FY2026-27 Budget Highlights

English: Further allocations include Ksh 5.9 billion for ongoing University Education projects, Ksh 4.9 billion for converting 20,000 intern teachers to permanent and pensionable terms from 1 January 2027, and Ksh 4.7 billion for the Kenya Secondary Education Quality Improvement Project.
Kiswahili: Mgao zaidi ni pamoja na Ksh bilioni 5.9 kwa miradi inayoendelea ya Elimu ya Vyuo Vikuu, Ksh bilioni 4.9 kwa ajili ya kuwabadilisha walimu 20,000 wa mafunzo kwa vitendo kuwa wa kudumu na wa kustaafu kuanzia Januari 1, 2027, na Ksh bilioni 4.7 kwa ajili ya Mradi wa Uboreshaji wa Ubora wa Elimu ya Sekondari ya Kenya.
Metadata: FY2026-27 Budget Highlights

English: The budget also allocates Ksh 4.1 billion for infrastructure development in primary and secondary schools, Ksh 4.0 billion for Higher Education Science, Technology and Research, and Ksh 3.0 billion for the School Feeding Programme.
Kiswahili: Bajeti hiyo pia inatenga Ksh bilioni 4.1 kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya miundombinu katika shule za msingi na sekondari, Ksh bilioni 4.0 kwa ajili ya Sayansi, Teknolojia na Utafiti wa Elimu ya Juu, na Ksh bilioni 3.0 kwa ajili ya Programu ya Kulisha Shuleni.
Metadata: FY2026-27 Budget Highlights

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, met with representatives from Shimizu Corporation at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Harambee Avenue to explore cooperation in engineering, research, and technology transfer.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alikutana na wawakilishi kutoka Shirika la Shimizu katika Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje kwenye Harambee Avenue ili kuchunguza ushirikiano katika uhandisi, utafiti, na uhamishaji wa teknolojia.
Metadata: Shimizu Corporation partnership

English: The proposed partnership will support student internships and training, faculty exchanges, and collaborative research in sustainable construction and infrastructure, aiming to unite government, universities, and industry to build technical capacity.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano uliopendekezwa utasaidia mafunzo ya wanafunzi na mafunzo, kubadilishana kwa wahadhiri, na utafiti shirikishi katika ujenzi endelevu na miundombinu, ukilenga kuunganisha serikali, vyuo vikuu, na tasnia ili kujenga uwezo wa kiufundi.
Metadata: Shimizu Corporation partnership

English: Also present were Ambassador Isiaya Kabira, Prof. Eng. Ayub Gitau, Vice-Chancellor of the University of Nairobi, Prof. Benedict M. Mutua, Vice-Chancellor of the Technical University of Kenya, and Shimizu representatives.
Kiswahili: Pia walikuwepo Balozi Isiaya Kabira, Prof. Eng. Ayub Gitau, Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi, Prof. Benedict M. Mutua, Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Ufundi cha Kenya, na wawakilishi wa Shimizu.
Metadata: Shimizu Corporation partnership

English: The Principal Secretary for Higher Education, Dr. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between Equity Bank and the European Union to expand scholarships for Kenyan students pursuing higher education at European universities.
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Juu, Dkt. Beatrice Muganda Inyangala, alishuhudia utiaji saini wa Mkataba wa Makubaliano kati ya Benki ya Equity na Umoja wa Ulaya ili kupanua ufadhili wa masomo kwa wanafunzi wa Kenya wanaofuata elimu ya juu katika vyuo vikuu vya Ulaya.
Metadata: Equity Bank-EU scholarship MOU

English: The partnership marks a step toward empowering young people through education, strengthening global academic linkages, and opening new pathways for talent development.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano huu unaashiria hatua kuelekea kuwawezesha vijana kupitia elimu, kuimarisha uhusiano wa kitaaluma wa kimataifa, na kufungua njia mpya za kukuza vipaji.
Metadata: Equity Bank-EU scholarship MOU

English: Also in attendance were Her Excellency Henriette Geiger, Ambassador of the European Union to Kenya, the Principal Secretary for Innovation and Research, Shaukat Abdulrazack, and Equity Group Foundation Executive Chairman Dr. James Mwangi.
Kiswahili: Pia waliohudhuria walikuwa Mheshimiwa Henriette Geiger, Balozi wa Umoja wa Ulaya nchini Kenya, Katibu Mkuu wa Ubunifu na Utafiti, Shaukat Abdulrazack, na Mwenyekiti Mtendaji wa Equity Group Foundation Dkt. James Mwangi.
Metadata: Equity Bank-EU scholarship MOU

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, joined the First Lady, Mama Rachel Ruto, together with the families and learners of Utumishi Girls Academy, for a requiem mass in honour of the young lives lost in the tragic fire at the institution.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, alijiunga na Mke wa Rais, Mama Rachel Ruto, pamoja na familia na wanafunzi wa Chuo cha Wasichana cha Utumishi, kwa misa ya wafu kwa heshima ya maisha ya vijana waliopotea katika moto mchungu katika taasisi hiyo.
Metadata: Utumishi Girls Academy requiem mass

English: The event reaffirmed the Government's commitment to building a safe and secure learning environment in which all learners can thrive and realise their full potential.
Kiswahili: Tukio hilo lilithibitisha tena dhamira ya Serikali ya kujenga mazingira salama ya kujifunzia ambapo wanafunzi wote wanaweza kustawi na kutambua uwezo wao kamili.
Metadata: Utumishi Girls Academy requiem mass

English: The Cabinet Secretary emphasized that through a multi-stakeholder approach, the Government will continue engaging all relevant actors to develop and implement sustainable strategies aimed at preventing the recurrence of such incidents in educational institutions.
Kiswahili: Waziri alisisitiza kwamba kupitia mbinu ya wadau wengi, Serikali itaendelea kuwashirikisha wahusika wote husika ili kuendeleza na kutekeleza mikakati endelevu inayolenga kuzuia kujirudia kwa matukio kama hayo katika taasisi za elimu.
Metadata: Utumishi Girls Academy requiem mass

English: The Ministry of Education's State Department for Basic Education paid tribute to the late Hon. Gideon Konchella, former Kilgoris Constituency MP, noting that during his two decades of service the constituency saw remarkable transformation in education, healthcare, and economic development.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Elimu ya Msingi ya Wizara ya Elimu ilitoa heshima kwa marehemu Mhe. Gideon Konchella, aliyekuwa Mbunge wa Jimbo la Kilgoris, ikibainisha kwamba wakati wa miongo miwili ya utumishi wake, jimbo hilo liliona mabadiliko makubwa katika elimu, huduma za afya, na maendeleo ya kiuchumi.
Metadata: Tribute to late Hon. Gideon Konchella

English: Hon. Konchella championed the establishment and growth of numerous educational institutions across Kilgoris Constituency, expanding access to learning opportunities for thousands of young people.
Kiswahili: Mhe. Konchella alitetea uanzishwaji na ukuaji wa taasisi nyingi za elimu katika Jimbo la Kilgoris, akipanua upatikanaji wa fursa za kujifunza kwa maelfu ya vijana.
Metadata: Tribute to late Hon. Gideon Konchella

English: The Cabinet Secretary for Education, Julius Migos Ogamba, on behalf of President Dr. William Samoei Ruto, graced the commemoration of the 80th Anniversary of the Thika School for the Visually Blind and the observance of International Albinism Awareness Day.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu, Julius Migos Ogamba, kwa niaba ya Rais Dkt. William Samoei Ruto, alihudhuria maadhimisho ya miaka 80 ya Shule ya Thika ya Watu Wenye Vipofu na maadhimisho ya Siku ya Kimataifa ya Uelewa wa Ualbino.
Metadata: Thika School for the Visually Blind, 80th anniversary
